one_line: Founding senapati of the Maitraka dynasty at Vallabhi in Saurashtra after Gupta power weakened.

appearance.age_look: Early forties, medium-tall, solid warrior’s build with broad shoulders and disciplined posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, wheatish Gujarat complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, default expression calm and authoritative with a hint of strategic vigilance.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a short, tidy topknot at the crown; front kept smooth with no loose bangs, wrapped at the base by a narrow maroon cloth band, no elaborate crown but a simple gold forehead chain with a small central disc resting above the brows.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton tunic (angarkha-style wrap) in deep indigo blue, tied at the right side with visible fabric knots; over it a sleeveless, hip‑length quilted cotton war vest in muted brick red with simple vertical stitch lines; below, a plainly draped off‑white cotton dhoti wrapped firmly and reaching to the ankles with a clean central pleat, and a dark brown leather belt securing the waist with a small metal buckle. A narrow maroon cotton stole runs from his left shoulder across the chest and back, tucked at the belt on the right side. His feet are in brown leather sandals with simple straps. He has a medium-width gold kada bracelet on each wrist, small round gold stud earrings, and a short, cylindrical gold amulet pendant on a cord at his neck; no heavy royal jewellery, emphasizing a practical commander rather than a crowned emperor.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-edged early Indian sword with a modest iron blade about the length of his forearm, slightly tapering to a point, with a simple bronze hilt and short crossbar, worn sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard hanging diagonally from his left hip; when unsheathed in art, he holds it in his right hand with the scabbard visible at his belt.

ref_desc: Bhatarka Maitraka is a wheatish Gujarat-complexioned, bearded commander with a tidy black topknot, deep indigo angarkha, brick red quilted war vest, off-white dhoti, gold accents, and a bronze-hilted straight sword in a dark brown scabbard at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Bhatarka Maitraka: an early-forties, medium-tall, broad-shouldered Gujarati senapati with an oval wheatish face, sharp dark eyes, and a neat short beard and moustache, standing calm and authoritative. His thick black hair is pulled into a compact topknot at the crown, bound with a narrow maroon band, and he wears a simple gold forehead chain with a small central disc above his brows. Dress him in a long-sleeved deep indigo wrap angarkha tunic tied on the right, overlaid by a sleeveless brick red quilted war vest with vertical stitching. Below, show an off-white dhoti firmly wrapped to the ankles with a clear front pleat, cinched by a dark brown leather belt. Add a narrow maroon stole from left shoulder to right waist, brown leather sandals, gold kada bracelets, small gold stud earrings, and a short cylindrical gold amulet pendant on a cord. His signature straight single-edged sword, with a modest iron blade and simple bronze hilt and crossbar, hangs sheathed in a dark brown scabbard from his left hip; in at least one pose he lightly grips the hilt to emphasize his military role. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, brick red, off-white, dark brown, and gold, keeping the overall look historically grounded, modestly clothed, and ready for action in multiple consistent views (front, side, and three-quarter).
